name: check_room
description: Checks whether a room can be booked for a given time interval. All times (start, end, now, and existing bookings) must be specified in whole minutes since midnight, within the range from 0 to 1440. This tool only evaluates availability and does not save or create any reservation or modify existing records.

start.description: Requested booking start time in whole minutes since midnight (0-1440).

end.description: Requested booking end time in whole minutes since midnight (0-1440).

now.description: Current time in whole minutes since midnight (0-1440).

blocked.description: Whether the room is currently blocked for maintenance or other reasons.

bookings.description: List of existing bookings for the room, each with start and end times in minutes since midnight.

start.description: Start time of existing booking in minutes since midnight.

end.description: End time of existing booking in minutes since midnight.
